repos.description: :zap: Dynamically generated stats for your github readmes
repos.summary_zh: GitHub Readme Stats 是一个动态生成 GitHub 统计信息的项目，可自动在个人 README 中展示仓库贡献、语言使用、活跃度等数据，支持高度自定义主题、布局与指标，提升开发者主页展示效果。
repos.summary_en: GitHub Readme Stats dynamically generates GitHub statistics for READMEs, displaying repository contributions, language usage, activity metrics, and more. It supports customizable themes, layouts, and options to enhance developer profile visibility.

repos.description: Simple and easy to use DDNS. Support Aliyun, Tencent Cloud, Dnspod, Cloudflare, Callback, Huawei Cloud, Baidu Cloud, Porkbun, GoDaddy, Namecheap, NameSilo...
repos.summary_zh: DDNS-GO 是一款轻量级动态域名解析服务工具，支持多平台（Mac/Windows/Linux）及主流云服务商（阿里云、腾讯云、Cloudflare等），自动获取公网 IPv4/IPv6 地址并更新对应域名记录。具备网页配置界面、日志查看、Webhook 通知、多级域名解析和自定义参数传递功能，支持 Docker 部署与系统服务化运行。
repos.summary_en: DDNS-GO is a lightweight dynamic DNS tool supporting multiple platforms (Mac/Windows/Linux) and cloud providers (Aliyun, Tencent Cloud, Cloudflare, etc.). It automatically fetches public IPv4/IPv6 addresses and updates domain records via a web-based interface. Features include multi-domain support, Webhook notifications, custom parameters, Docker deployment, and system service integration.

repos.description: An all-in-one email service platform powered by Cloudflare  | 基于 Cloudflare 的一站式邮箱服务平台  | Cloudflare Email 邮箱 Mail
repos.summary_zh: 基于 Cloudflare Workers 构建的轻量级邮箱服务，集成 Resend 邮件发送、R2 附件存储与 D1 数据库，支持多用户管理、权限控制及数据可视化。采用 Vue3 + Element Plus 实现响应式界面，通过 Turnstile 人机验证保障安全，提供 API 接口与邮件推送功能，显著降低自建邮箱成本。
repos.summary_en: A lightweight email service built on Cloudflare Workers, integrating Resend for email delivery, R2 for file storage, and D1 for database operations. Features multi-user management, RBAC permissions, responsive UI with Vue3/Element Plus, Turnstile anti-bot protection, API endpoints, and data visualization via ECharts, offering a cost-effective self-hosted email solution.

repos.description: CloudFlare free temp domain email 免费收发 临时域名邮箱 支持附件 IMAP SMTP TelegramBot
repos.summary_zh: 基于 Cloudflare Workers 构建的免费临时邮箱服务，支持收发邮件、附件处理、IMAP/SMTP 协议及 Telegram 机器人通知，采用 Rust WASM 实现高性能邮件解析，提供现代化多语言响应式界面，支持邮箱地址密码保护，完全免费且无需服务器部署。
repos.summary_en: A fully-featured free temporary email service built on Cloudflare Workers, supporting email sending/receiving, attachments, IMAP/SMTP protocols, and Telegram bot notifications. Uses Rust WASM for high-performance email parsing, offers a modern responsive UI with multi-language support, and enables password protection for email addresses—all at zero cost with no server required.

repos.description: 收集整理远程工作相关的资料
repos.summary_zh: 该仓库系统整理远程工作相关资源，涵盖文章、问题解答、团队案例、视频播客、工具站点等，聚焦中国受众，提供远程办公经验分享、招聘信息、协作工具推荐及行业报告，助力远程工作者获取实用信息与职业发展支持。
repos.summary_en: This repository curates comprehensive resources on remote work, including articles, Q&A, team cases, videos, podcasts, tools, and reports, primarily targeting Chinese audiences. It offers practical guidance on remote work, job opportunities, collaboration tools, and industry insights to support freelancers and remote professionals.

repos.description: 这个项目是一个基于 Cloudflare Workers 的 Docker 镜像代理工具。它能够中转对 Docker 官方镜像仓库的请求，解决一些访问限制和加速访问的问题。
repos.summary_zh: 基于 Cloudflare Workers 的 Docker 镜像代理工具，通过中转请求解决官方仓库访问限制与加速问题。支持 Docker、Containerd、Podman 等多种容器运行时配置镜像加速，提供一键部署方案，适用于跨境网络环境下的镜像拉取优化。
repos.summary_en: A Docker image proxy tool built on Cloudflare Workers that relays requests to official repositories to bypass access restrictions and accelerate downloads. Supports configuration for Docker, Containerd, and Podman runtimes with one-click deployment options, ideal for optimizing image pulls in cross-border networks.

repos.description: 🏖️ A serverless, open-source file hosting solution built on Cloudflare. Supports image hosting, secure file storage, and personal cloud drive capabilities.
repos.summary_zh: CloudFlare-ImgBed 是一个基于 Cloudflare 的无服务器开源文件托管解决方案，支持 Docker 和 Serverless 部署。它提供图片托管、安全文件存储和个人云盘功能，兼容 Telegram、Discord、R2、S3、Huggingface、WebDAV 等多种存储后端，并内置 RESTful API 与 WebDAV 支持，适用于轻量级私有云搭建。
repos.summary_en: CloudFlare-ImgBed is a serverless, open-source file hosting solution built on Cloudflare. It supports image hosting, secure file storage, and personal cloud drive capabilities via Docker or serverless deployment. Compatible with multiple storage backends like R2, S3, WebDAV, and more, it offers RESTful APIs and WebDAV support for flexible integration.

repos.description: One Worker, All Subscriptions
repos.summary_zh: Sublink Worker 是一个轻量级订阅转换与管理工具，支持 ShadowSocks、VLESS、Hysteria2 等主流代理协议，兼容 Sing-Box、Clash 等客户端。通过 Cloudflare Workers、Vercel 或 Docker 一键部署，提供 KV 存储的短链生成、多语言界面及自动化 API，适用于个人或团队统一管理多源代理订阅。
repos.summary_en: Sublink Worker is a lightweight subscription converter and manager supporting proxy protocols like ShadowSocks, VLESS, and Hysteria2. Deployable on Cloudflare Workers, Vercel, or Docker, it offers short-link generation via KV storage, multi-language UI, and automation APIs for unified management of proxy subscriptions across clients such as Sing-Box and Clash.

repos.description: 🌸Publish faster with an edge-native blog powered by Cloudflare Workers, D1, and R2
repos.summary_zh: Rin是一个基于Cloudflare全栈无服务器架构的现代博客平台，集成Pages、Workers、D1和R2服务。支持GitHub OAuth登录、富文本编辑、实时自动保存、私有文章控制、图片拖拽上传、自定义URL别名、友链检测、评论系统及Webhook通知等功能，实现零运维部署的个人博客解决方案。
repos.summary_en: Rin is a modern serverless blog platform built entirely on Cloudflare's developer platform, integrating Pages, Workers, D1, and R2. It features GitHub OAuth authentication, rich text editing, real-time autosave, privacy controls, image management, custom slugs, unlisted posts, blogroll with link validation, comment system, and webhook notifications for a fully managed blogging experience.

repos.description: A cute temporary email service built with NextJS + Cloudflare technology stack 🎉 | 一个基于 NextJS + Cloudflare 技术栈构建的可爱临时邮箱服务🎉
repos.summary_zh: MoeMail 是一个基于 Next.js 和 Cloudflare 技术栈构建的可爱临时邮箱服务，提供隐私保护、实时邮件接收、灵活有效期设置、主题切换、PWA 支持等功能，支持自建部署、邮件发送、Webhook 通知及 OpenAPI 访问，界面简洁友好，适合个人或团队使用。
repos.summary_en: MoeMail is a cute temporary email service built with Next.js and Cloudflare, offering privacy protection, real-time email receipt, flexible validity periods, theme switching, PWA support, and self-hosting capabilities. It supports email sending, webhook notifications, OpenAPI access, and a user-friendly interface for personal or team use.

repos.description: 一个基于 AI 的 Hacker News 中文播客项目，每天自动抓取 Hacker News 热门文章，通过 AI 生成中文总结并转换为播客内容。
repos.summary_zh: Agili 的 Hacker Podcast 是一个基于 AI 的 Hacker News 中文播客项目，每日自动抓取热门文章，利用 AI 生成中文摘要并转换为语音播客。项目采用 Cloudflare Workers 部署，结合 OpenAI API 与 TTS 技术，支持多平台订阅，实现技术资讯的自动化聚合与分发。
repos.summary_en: Agili's Hacker Podcast is an AI-powered Chinese podcast project that automatically fetches daily top articles from Hacker News, generates Chinese summaries via AI, and converts them into audio content. Built with Cloudflare Workers, OpenAI API, and TTS, it supports multi-platform RSS and web access for automated tech news aggregation.

repos.description: AI资讯日报 是一个基于 Cloudflare Workers 驱动的内容聚合与生成平台。它每日为您精选 AI 领域的最新动态，包括行业新闻、热门开源项目、前沿学术论文、科技大V社交媒体言论，并通过 Google Gemini 模型进行智能处理与摘要生成，最终自动发布到 GitHub Pages 生成 AI 日报。
repos.summary_zh: AI资讯日报是基于Cloudflare Workers构建的自动化内容聚合平台，每日精选AI领域新闻、开源项目与学术论文，通过Google Gemini生成智能摘要并发布至GitHub Pages。支持Folo订阅源接入，提供网页、RSS及微信公众号多端阅读体验，兼具技术学习价值与个人定制潜力。
repos.summary_en: AI Insight Daily is an automated content aggregation platform built on Cloudflare Workers. It curates daily AI news, open-source projects, and research papers, generating intelligent summaries via Google Gemini and publishing them to GitHub Pages. Supports Folo RSS feeds, offering multi-platform access via web, RSS, and WeChat Official Account, serving as both a learning resource and customizable tool.

repos.description: Multi-service toolkit for Tavily and Firecrawl signup automation, key validation, and isolated proxy pools.
repos.summary_zh: 该仓库是一个多服务注册与API密钥管理工具，专注于自动化注册并验证Tavily、Firecrawl和Exa的API密钥。通过真实浏览器模拟注册流程、集成Turnstile验证码破解、自动收取邮箱验证码，并对获取的密钥进行实际调用验证，确保可用性。支持跨平台运行，可选将密钥上传至统一代理池，专为MySearch-Proxy等聚合搜索网关提供稳定可靠的密钥上游来源。
repos.summary_en: This repository provides a multi-service toolkit for automating registration and validation of API keys from Tavily, Firecrawl, and Exa. It simulates real browser signups, integrates Turnstile solver, auto-collects email verification codes, and validates keys via live API calls to ensure functionality. Cross-platform compatible, with optional upload to a unified proxy pool, serving as a reliable upstream key provider for aggregation search gateways like MySearch-Proxy.

repos.description: MemFree - Hybrid AI Search Engine & AI Page Generator
repos.summary_zh: MemFree 是一款混合 AI 搜索引擎与 AI 页面生成器，支持多模态输入（文本/图片/文件）、多 AI 模型（Claude/GPT/Gemini）及多搜索引擎，可快速检索知识库与全网信息并生成生产级 UI 页面，显著提升效率并降低成本。
repos.summary_en: MemFree is a Hybrid AI Search Engine & AI Page Generator that supports multimodal inputs (text/images/files), integrates multiple AI models (Claude/GPT/Gemini) and search engines, enabling fast retrieval from knowledge bases and the web, plus instant generation of production-ready UI pages to boost efficiency and reduce costs.

repos.description: 一个基于 NextJS + Cloudflare 技术栈构建的可爱消息推送服务, 支持多种消息推送渠道✨
repos.summary_zh: MoePush 是基于 Next.js 和 Cloudflare 构建的开源消息推送服务，支持钉钉、企业微信、Telegram 等 8 种推送渠道，提供简洁的 API 接口与精美 UI，采用 Drizzle ORM 和 D1 数据库，支持 GitHub 登录与 Docker 部署，适合快速集成多平台消息通知。
repos.summary_en: MoePush is an open-source message push service built with Next.js and Cloudflare, supporting 8+ channels including DingTalk, WeCom, and Telegram. It offers a clean API, shadcn/ui-based UI, GitHub OAuth, D1 database via Drizzle ORM, and Docker deployment for easy multi-platform notification integration.

repos.description: NaviHive 是一个精美的个人网站导航管理系统，帮助你整理和管理你收藏的网站链接。支持分组管理、拖拽排序、暗色模式等功能，让你的网站收藏更有条理、更易访问。
repos.summary_zh: NaviHive 是一个基于 Cloudflare Workers 构建的现代化个人网站导航管理系统，支持分组管理、拖拽排序和暗色模式。采用 React + TypeScript + Material UI 技术栈，零成本部署于全球 CDN，提供企业级安全与快速访问体验。
repos.summary_en: NaviHive is a modern personal website navigation management system built on Cloudflare Workers. It supports grouping, drag-and-drop sorting, and dark mode. Powered by React, TypeScript, and Material UI, it offers zero-cost deployment with global CDN acceleration and enterprise-grade security.

repos.description: Selfhost web archiving and sharing service.
repos.summary_zh: 基于 Cloudflare Worker 的免费网页归档与分享服务，提供浏览器插件、云端存储和检索功能。支持单文件 HTML 保存、文件夹分类、AI 标签生成及移动端适配，实现网页内容的永久存档与便捷共享。
repos.summary_en: A free web archiving and sharing service built on Cloudflare Workers, featuring a browser plugin for saving webpages as single HTML files, cloud-based storage with D1 database and R2 bucket, AI-generated tags, folder organization, and mobile-optimized reading mode.

repos.description: 使用vercel的functions，将ai功能加入微信公众号
repos.summary_zh: 该项目利用 Vercel Functions 实现零服务器成本部署，将 AI 功能接入微信公众号，支持 GPT、星火、通义千问、Gemini 等多种大模型，具备连续对话、自定义指令、关键词回复、图床等功能，通过 Redis 实现会话记忆，无需备案域名即可运行。
repos.summary_en: This project leverages Vercel Functions to deploy AI-powered WeChat Official Account integration with zero server cost. It supports multiple AI models (GPT, Spark, Qwen, Gemini), continuous conversations via Redis, custom commands, keyword replies, image hosting, and system prompt configuration, all without domain registration or server maintenance.

repos.description: Grok2API (Cloudflare Workers) one-click deploy with auto D1+KV provisioning
repos.summary_zh: Grok2API 是基于 FastAPI 重构的 Grok AI 代理服务，支持 Cloudflare Workers/D1+KV 一键部署，提供流/非流式对话、图像生成、深度思考等功能。具备号池并发、自动负载均衡、Token/API Key 管理、后台面板等核心能力，三端部署行为一致，适配移动端并增强筛选与状态判定逻辑。
repos.summary_en: Grok2API is a FastAPI-based proxy for Grok AI, supporting one-click deployment on Cloudflare Workers/D1+KV with streaming/non-streaming chat, image generation, deep thinking, concurrent token pools, and auto load balancing. It features unified management panels, mobile adaptation, enhanced token filtering, and consistent behavior across local/FastAPI/Docker/Workers deployments.

repos.description: A smart and beautiful markdown editor.
repos.summary_zh: Markcook 是一款基于 Vue 2.0 和 Vuex 2.0 开发的智能美观 Markdown 编辑器，采用 Google Material Design 风格。支持多文件切换、拖拽加载、自动保存至本地存储、一键插入 Markdown 语法及导出为 Markdown 或 HTML 文件，提供流畅的动画交互与护眼配色，兼具在线便捷性与本地应用体验。
repos.summary_en: Markcook is a smart and beautiful markdown editor built with VueJS 2.0 and Vuex 2.0, featuring Google Material Design. It supports multi-file editing, drag-and-drop loading, auto-save to local storage, toolbar-based markdown insertion, and export to .md or .html. With smooth animations, low-contrast colors, and componentized architecture, it offers a seamless online experience akin to desktop apps.

repos.description: ✨一个部署在CF的轻量化导航页面，可移动卡片式书签，方便管理
repos.summary_zh: Card-Tab 是一个部署在 Cloudflare Workers 上的轻量化书签管理页面，采用卡片式布局支持拖拽排序、分类管理和暗色主题切换。具备多搜索引擎集成、JWT登录验证、KV存储备份及实时天气显示等功能，适合个人快速搭建个性化导航站。
repos.summary_en: Card-Tab is a lightweight bookmark management page deployed on Cloudflare Workers, featuring card-based layout with drag-and-drop sorting, custom categories, dark mode, and multi-engine search. It supports JWT authentication, KV storage backups, and real-time weather display for personalized navigation.

repos.description: Two Factor Authentication
repos.summary_zh: 基于 Cloudflare Workers 的轻量级两步验证密钥管理系统，支持 TOTP/HOTP 生成、多方式添加密钥（扫码/图片识别/拖拽/粘贴）、AES-256-GCM 加密存储，兼容主流应用批量导入导出，具备 WebDAV/S3 远程同步、自动备份还原及响应式设计，实现免费全球部署与离线 PWA 使用。
repos.summary_en: A lightweight two-factor authentication (2FA) key management system built on Cloudflare Workers, supporting TOTP/HOTP generation, multi-method key addition (QR scan/image recognition/drag-and-drop/paste), AES-256-GCM encryption, batch import/export from major apps, WebDAV/S3 sync, auto backup/restore, and responsive design for offline PWA use with global free deployment.

repos.description: 基于deno的抖音视频图文无水印下载，支持cf worker,vercel,deno deploy,docker部署
repos.summary_zh: 基于 Deno 的抖音无水印视频与图文下载服务，支持多平台部署（Deno Deploy、Cloudflare Workers、Vercel、Docker），通过简单 API 调用即可解析并返回原始媒体链接，适用于内容抓取与自动化处理场景。
repos.summary_en: A Deno-based service for downloading watermark-free Douyin videos and images via URL parsing, supporting deployment on Deno Deploy, Cloudflare Workers, Vercel, and Docker. Provides clean media links through a simple GET API for content extraction and automation.

repos.description: GithubAction的使用样例，天气推送，薅羊毛，打卡签到
repos.summary_zh: 本项目为 GitHub Actions 实战样例，演示如何通过无服务器 Python 程序实现自动化任务。核心功能包括跨平台画爱心程序构建、微信公众号天气推送及京东签到薅羊毛。通过 Secrets 管理敏感信息，支持定时任务调度，适合学习 CI/CD 与自动化运维。
repos.summary_en: This repository provides practical examples of GitHub Actions for serverless automation. Key features include cross-platform executable generation (e.g., drawing hearts), weather push notifications via WeChat Official Account, and JD.com daily check-in 'money-saving' bots. It uses GitHub Secrets for secure credential management and cron-based scheduling.

repos.description: BetterClaude API Gateway
repos.summary_zh: BetterClaude Gateway 是一个基于 Cloudflare Workers 的智能 Claude API 代理，专为解决工具调用中 orphaned tool_result 错误而设计。它能主动检测并清除消息历史中无效的 tool_result 块，支持透明转发、智能重试和边缘计算，显著提升 Claude API 在复杂对话场景下的稳定性与可用性。
repos.summary_en: BetterClaude Gateway is an intelligent Claude API proxy built on Cloudflare Workers, specifically designed to fix orphaned tool_result errors. It proactively detects and removes invalid tool_result blocks from message history, supports transparent forwarding, smart retry with reactive fallback, and leverages edge computing for global low-latency access, greatly improving reliability in complex tool-use scenarios.

repos.description: 一个简单的网络分析跟踪器和仪表板，在 Cloudflare Pages 上即可快速部署的网站分析仪表板,无成本稳定运行
repos.summary_zh: Han-Analytics 是一个基于 Cloudflare Pages 的无服务器网站分析工具，提供轻量级网络跟踪与可视化仪表板功能，支持零成本部署、高并发访问（每日10万次免费统计），具备密码保护和网站白名单等安全特性，适用于个人或企业快速集成网站数据分析。
repos.summary_en: Han-Analytics is a serverless web analytics tool built on Cloudflare Pages, offering lightweight tracking and dashboard visualization with zero-cost deployment, high-concurrency support (up to 100k daily free stats), password protection, and website whitelisting for secure data collection and analysis.

repos.description: A multi-model AI Telegram bot powered by Cloudflare Workers, supporting various APIs including OpenAI, Claude, and Azure. Developed in TypeScript with a modular design for easy expansion.基于 Cloudflare Workers 的多模型 AI Telegram 机器人，支持 OpenAI、Claude、Azure 等多个 API，采用 TypeScript 开发，模块化设计便于扩展。
repos.summary_zh: 基于 Cloudflare Workers 的多模型 AI Telegram 机器人，支持 OpenAI、Claude、Azure 等多个 API，采用 TypeScript 开发，模块化设计便于扩展。具备智能对话、图像生成与分析、多语言支持等功能，通过 Redis 缓存提升性能，适用于构建高效可扩展的 AI 聊天服务。
repos.summary_en: A multi-model AI Telegram bot built with TypeScript on Cloudflare Workers, supporting APIs from OpenAI, Claude, Azure, and more. Features modular architecture for easy expansion, including intelligent conversation, image generation/analysis, multilingual support, and Redis caching for high-performance deployment.

repos.description: Cloudflare Worker; Claude Code; Proxy; Easy to deploy; Claude Code Router; claude-code-router; ccr; alternate
repos.summary_zh: 该项目是一个基于 Cloudflare Worker 的 Claude Code 代理工具，支持将 Gemini 和 OpenAI 等第三方大模型 API 转换为 Claude 格式，实现零配置快速部署。核心特性包括流式响应、工具调用支持，并可通过 One-Balance 实现低成本 Claude Code 使用。
repos.summary_en: This project is a Cloudflare Worker-based proxy that converts third-party LLM APIs (Gemini, OpenAI) into Claude-compatible format, enabling zero-config deployment. It supports streaming/non-streaming responses, tool calls, and integrates with One-Balance for cost-effective Claude Code usage.

repos.description: 这是一个部署在 Cloudflare Workers 上的 TypeScript 项目，它充当一个代理服务器，能够将 Claude API 格式的请求无缝转换为 OpenAI API 格式。这使得任何与 Claude API 兼容的客户端（例如官方的 @anthropic-ai/claude-code CLI）都能够与任何支持 OpenAI API 格式的服务进行通信，如 Google Gemini, Groq, Ollama 等。
repos.summary_zh: 该项目是一个部署在 Cloudflare Workers 上的 TypeScript 代理服务器，可将 Claude API 请求无缝转换为 OpenAI API 格式，支持动态路由至 Google Gemini、Groq、Ollama 等兼容服务，具备全功能 API 兼容、函数调用转换、Haiku 模型快捷配置及一键部署脚本，实现 Claude 客户端与多 AI 服务的无缝互通。
repos.summary_en: This is a TypeScript project deployed on Cloudflare Workers that acts as a proxy server, seamlessly converting Claude API requests to OpenAI API format. It enables any Claude-compatible client (e.g., @anthropic-ai/claude-code) to communicate with OpenAI-compatible services like Google Gemini, Groq, and Ollama via dynamic routing, full API compatibility, tool calling conversion, and one-click deployment.

repos.description: 临时邮箱 - 匿名的一次性邮箱（无需登录，打开即用）
repos.summary_zh: 基于 Golang + Astro + React 构建的匿名临时邮箱服务，支持长轮询实时接收邮件、CSS样式隔离、暗色主题切换及附件下载，无需登录即可快速注册保护隐私，适用于防垃圾邮件和批量账号注册场景。
repos.summary_en: Anonymous disposable email service built with Golang, Astro, and React, featuring real-time email delivery via long polling, CSS isolation, dark mode, and attachment support—ideal for privacy protection and spam-free account registration.

repos.description: 节点过滤器
repos.summary_zh: ProxyFilter 是基于 Cloudflare Workers 的 Clash 代理配置过滤工具，支持多格式输入（YAML、Base64、URI列表），智能匹配中英文地区名称，过滤 VMess、Shadowsocks、Trojan 等协议节点，自动去重并支持多源合并与自定义命名，适用于高效管理代理订阅。
repos.summary_en: ProxyFilter is a Cloudflare Workers-based tool for filtering Clash proxy configurations. It supports multiple input formats (YAML, Base64, URI lists), intelligently matches region names in Chinese and English, filters nodes by protocol (VMess, Shadowsocks, Trojan, etc.), removes duplicates, and merges multiple sources with customizable naming.

repos.description: 【abcd修改版-个人用】托管在cloudflare上的轻量化导航，可以同步谷歌书签
repos.summary_zh: CloudNav-abcd 是基于 Cloudflare Pages 的免费个人导航站，支持谷歌书签同步、AI智能分类与简介生成、WebDAV双重备份及密码保护。提供拖拽排序、右键快捷操作、Chrome扩展插件等高效功能，适配多端访问，适合个人知识管理。
repos.summary_en: CloudNav-abcd is a free personal navigation site hosted on Cloudflare Pages, supporting Google bookmark sync, AI-powered auto-categorization and descriptions, WebDAV dual backup, and password protection. Features drag-and-drop sorting, right-click shortcuts, Chrome extension, and cross-device access for efficient knowledge management.

repos.description: Deployed on Cloudflare Worker, using the free Flux model and optimizing prompts with LLM. It can be called from any application compatible with the OpenAI API. 部署于Cloudflare Worker，免费使用Flux模型，并通过LLM进行提示词优化，支持在任何兼容OpenAI API的应用中调用。
repos.summary_zh: Flux-API-Worker 是一个部署在 Cloudflare Worker 上的 AI 图像生成服务，免费使用 Flux 模型并通过 LLM 优化提示词，提供兼容 OpenAI API 的接口，支持自定义提示、多尺寸输出、KV 缓存及 CORS，适用于各类应用集成。
repos.summary_en: Flux-API-Worker is an AI image generation service deployed on Cloudflare Workers, utilizing the free Flux model and LLM-powered prompt optimization. It offers an OpenAI-compatible API for seamless integration into any application, supporting custom prompts, multiple aspect ratios, KV storage, and streaming responses.

repos.description: 🚀轻量级 Cloudflare IP 优选工具
repos.summary_zh: NekoFlare 是一款基于 UCB 算法的轻量级 Cloudflare IP 优选工具，通过多臂老虎机模型动态评估边缘节点性能。结合 TCP 延迟与 HTTP 吞吐量加权评分，实现探索与利用的平衡，自动收敛至最优网段。支持 IPv4/IPv6 扫描，无需第三方依赖，适用于本地 hosts 优化。
repos.summary_en: NekoFlare is a lightweight tool for optimizing Cloudflare edge node selection using the Upper Confidence Bound (UCB) algorithm. It employs a multi-armed bandit model to balance exploration and exploitation, dynamically scoring IPs based on TCP latency and HTTP throughput. Automatically converges to optimal subnets while supporting IPv4/IPv6 scanning with zero external dependencies.

repos.description: 开源AI生图工具，免登录畅玩 FLUX2、SDXL，支持 cloudflare workers 一键部署自托管，并集成各大主流AI提供商，提供一站式的创作体验。
repos.summary_zh: Typix 是一款开源 AI 生图工具，支持免登录使用 FLUX2、SDXL 等主流模型，提供 Cloudflare Workers 一键自托管部署，集成 Google、OpenAI、Fal 等多平台 AI 服务，兼具浏览器本地存储与可选云同步，保障用户数据隐私与创作自由。
repos.summary_en: Typix is an open-source AI image generation tool that enables login-free access to FLUX2, SDXL, and other models. It offers one-click self-hosting via Cloudflare Workers, integrates multiple AI providers like Google and OpenAI, and supports local browser storage with optional cloud sync for privacy and seamless cross-device creativity.

repos.description: 利用bpb漏洞获取免费的节点，cloudflareWorkers部署
repos.summary_zh: 基于BPB面板漏洞的免费节点生成工具，通过Cloudflare Workers实现自动化部署，支持一键获取免费节点，降低使用门槛，适合小白用户快速上手。
repos.summary_en: A free node generator exploiting BPB panel vulnerabilities, deployed via Cloudflare Workers for one-click access to nodes, enabling easy setup and continuous availability for users.

repos.summary_zh: 基于 Cloudflare Workers 的 Grok AI 代理服务，提供 OpenAI 兼容 API 和可视化 Web 管理界面，支持文本对话、多规格图片生成及视频创作，具备 Token 自动轮换、API Key 速率限制与一键部署能力。
repos.summary_en: A Cloudflare Workers-based proxy for Grok AI, offering OpenAI-compatible APIs and a web admin interface. Supports text chat, image/video generation with customizable ratios, token auto-rotation, rate limiting, and one-click deployment.

repos.description: 即梦海外版 | Dreamina (CapCut AI) 图像生成 API | 基于 Cloudflare Workers 部署
repos.summary_zh: 即梦海外版 Dreamina API 基于 Cloudflare Workers 构建，采用异步任务模式解决30秒超时限制。支持文生图、图生图及多模型（4.5/4.1/4.0），提供 OpenAI 兼容接口与可视化 Web 界面，全球边缘节点部署，无需服务器即可实现 AI 图像生成服务。
repos.summary_en: Dreamina API (CapCut AI) built on Cloudflare Workers uses asynchronous task mode to bypass 30s timeout limits. Supports text-to-image, image-to-image, and multiple models (4.5/4.1/4.0), offers OpenAI-compatible endpoints with a visual web interface, and deploys globally via edge nodes without server infrastructure.

repos.description: 基于 Cloudflare Workers + D1 的临时邮箱控制台。接收邮件后，根据可配置的正则规则自动提取关键数据（如验证码），并通过 API 对外提供查询能力。
repos.summary_zh: 基于 Cloudflare Workers + D1 的无服务器临时邮箱系统，支持自动接收邮件、正则规则提取验证码等关键信息，并提供 RESTful API 查询接口。具备白名单过滤、邮件转发、定时清理及可视化控制台管理功能，适用于自动化验证与数据采集场景。
repos.summary_en: A serverless temporary email console built with Cloudflare Workers and D1, automatically receives emails, extracts key data (e.g., verification codes) via configurable regex rules, and exposes a RESTful API for querying. Features include sender whitelisting, email forwarding, cron-based cleanup, and a web admin console for management.

repos.description: 基于service worker与单页面应用的静态页面博客系统
repos.summary_zh: swBlog 是一个基于 Service Worker 和单页应用（SPA）的静态博客系统，支持 Markdown 写作、离线阅读与搜索功能。可部署于 GitHub Pages 或 CDN，具备文章分类、标签生成及自动化构建流程，适用于个人技术博客与知识分享场景。
repos.summary_en: swBlog is a static blog system built with Service Worker and SPA, supporting Markdown writing, offline reading, and search. Deployable on GitHub Pages or CDN, it auto-generates categories/tags from file structure and enables automated builds via npm scripts for personal tech blogs.
